data_fields.name: splatter_size_byte
data_fields.donor_constant: TE size byte (0-255) read from the message

best_idea: Cap how many decals can stack on one patch of floor: when a new splat would be the seventh heavy overlap, replace the least-covered older splat instead of adding a new one, and keep one global pool cap.
decision_why: Take the per-surface overlap cap, the least-covered steal and a global pool cap as a phone budget; drop the BSP walk and geometry clipping (our arena floor is one plane) and keep blood a client cosmetic that never feeds back into the fight.
acceptance: On one patch of sand a seventh heavy splat replaces the least-covered older splat, so no spot shows more than six stacked splats; total splats stay at or below the phone pool cap; a server test asserts blood decals never change health or the kill.
